sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Firework is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "You're looking suspiciously cheerful, man! Doesn't exactly look like you've been sweating and pushing yourself to the limit. Maybe you go to these revamped matches just to watch the fireworks from a safe distance instead of actually stepping into hell? Say what you want, but I need results. Don't avoid the fight or the device's blast zone. Get in close, fight hard, and win me a victory! But one won't be enough. I know you can do more. Come on, pull yourself together!"
